mechanism: Posaconazole inhibits CYP3A4, increasing albendazole metabolism and systemic exposure; albendazole may induce posaconazole metabolism, reducing antifungal efficacy.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of posaconazole closely; consider alternative anthelmintic or antifungal agent; if concurrent use necessary, ensure adequate posaconazole dosing and monitor for both efficacy and albendazole toxicity.
